title: Packers sign Mekhi Becton to 53-man roster, put Jacob Monk on IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Packers sign Mekhi Becton to 53-man roster, put Jacob Monk on IR
sources.description: The Packers had a couple of offensive linemen go down with injuries in Sunday's loss to the Lions and they moved one of them to injured reserve on Monday.
